//: 13.7-inch paratrooper barrel for the M249. Sets the host gun's barrel_length (engine honors gunmod barrel_length, item.cpp), shortening reach/velocity but making the gun handier. ZERO_WEIGHT so a swap doesn't inflate the gun's weight.
description: The stubby 13.7-inch quick-change barrel issued with the paratrooper M249.  It trades muzzle velocity and reach for a much handier, more maneuverable weapon, at the cost of a louder, flashier report.

//: Cut-down ~18.5-inch barrel for the M240, the 'Shorty' configuration. Sets the host gun's barrel_length; ZERO_WEIGHT so the swap doesn't add weight.
description: A shortened quick-change barrel for the M240 medium machine gun, roughly 18.5 inches against the standard 21.7.  It makes the unwieldy belt-fed gun noticeably handier for assault work, giving up some reach and muzzle velocity and barking considerably louder for it.
